en.title: Australia Launches $200M Inclusive Communities Fund Consultation for Disability Access
en.summary: Australian Government opened consultation for a $200 million Inclusive Communities Fund to boost disability participation in social, recreational, arts, sports, and cultural activities over three years. Also highlighted were a barrier‑free beach event in Japan and reports of a shortage of group homes for people with severe disabilities across 30 prefectures. Developers can test web accessibility using 20 browser‑based exercises covering keyboard navigation, ARIA labels, contrast, and focus management.

highlights.title: Consultation opens for Inclusive Communities Fund
Shortage of Group Homes for People with Severe Disabilities in Japan
Web Accessibility: 20 Exercises You Can Check Right in the Browser

zh-TW.title: 澳洲啟動2億美元包容性社區基金諮詢
zh-TW.summary: 澳大利亞政府已啟動總額2億美元的包容性社區基金諮詢，計畫於未來三年內提升殘障人士在社會、休閒、藝術、體育及文化活動中的參與度。同時，日本舉辦無障礙海灘活動「大家的美雪海灘」，並有報告指出全國30個縣府約有20,000名殘障人士等待團體住宅安置。開發者可透過20項瀏覽器網頁無障礙練習，檢查鍵盤導航、ARIA標籤、顏色對比與焦點管理。

highlights.title: 包容性社區基金諮詢啟動
無障礙海灘活動『大家的美雪海灘』
日本嚴重殘障人士團體住宅短缺
網頁無障礙：可直接在瀏覽器中檢查的20項練習
